title: Donald Glover 将执导并主演 Netflix 改编的 PUBG Battlegrounds
content:
Netflix to adapt Krafton's PUBG Battlegrounds with Donald Glover
Business
News
Donald Glover to direct, star in Netflix adaptation of PUBG Battlegrounds
An adaptation of the battle royale shooter has been picked up by Netflix, with protean entertainer Donald Glover to write, produce, and star in the adaptation.
Imran Khan
,
Contributing Editor
October 29, 2026
schedule
1 Min Read
Image via Krafton
Newsbrief:
Krafton has announced that
PUBG Battlegrounds
(formerly known as
PlayerUnknown's Battlegrounds
) is being adapted by Netflix as a live-action series, with actor and musician Donald Glover penning, producing, and starring in the adaptation.
Before the game went free-to-play,
PUBG
sold over 75 million copies, with numerous spin-offs of
varying levels of success
.
Glover is a well-known rapper and actor of considerable acclaim, acting in the Dan Harmon comedy Community as a principal lead, headlining prestige drama Atlanta, and winning two Primetime Emmy awards and two Golden Globes for his work.
There was no timeline given for the
PUBG
adaptation.
